<!--
PURPOSE  Turn the raw NHANES file into ONE clean dataset that Parts 2, 3 and 4
         all use. Every step is justified by a finding in 01_exploration.
INPUT    data/raw/NHANES_20212023_merged_filtered_1.csv + codebook
OUTPUT   data/processed/nhanes_clean.csv     (participants x selected variables)
         data/processed/variable_info.csv    (one row per kept variable: label, role, transformation)
OWNER    Person 1
RULE     Downstream scripts never repeat cleaning steps: if something needs to
         change, change it HERE and re-knit, so every part uses the same data.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "utils.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150,
                      dev = c("png", "cairo_pdf"),
                      fig.path = file.path(paths$figures, "02_preprocessing", ""))
```

```{r load}
nhanes_raw <- load_raw_data()
codebook   <- load_codebook()
dim(nhanes_raw)
```

# Save the clean dataset

```{r save}
dir.create(dirname(paths$clean_data), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(nhanes_clean, paths$clean_data)

variable_info <- codebook %>% filter(variable %in% names(nhanes_clean))
write_csv(variable_info, paths$clean_vars)

dim(nhanes_clean)
```
